{{Quote|Well, anyway. I'm Jenica Sonsen, C-point COO Ad-Op.''"''<br />''"''What?''"''<br />''"''Sorry. Force of habit. Centerpoint Chief Operations Officer, Administration and Operations. Basically, I run the place, these days.|Jenica Sonsen and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SAC" />}}
'''Jenica Sonsen''' was the administrator of [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]] and throughout the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. She was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] with expressive eyebrows, curly black hair, and a long thin face.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Maybe you've got a point. But I have to know what you're doing here. Your ships blew out of nowhere and then those fighters bugged out too.|Jenica Sonsen|<ref name="SAC" />}}
Sonsen had an important role in the Centerpoint Crisis guiding around [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Belindi Kalenda]], and [[Gaeriel Captison]]. She even was attracted to Lando and tried to move on her feelings, which Lando refused due to making a previous promise to another [[Tendra Risant Calrissian|person]].<ref name="SAC" />

She continued in that job as late as [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], when she was heading the team that was attempting to map the station's interior.<ref name="Eclipse">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>
